_readme: DOCUMENTATION — a human/agent-facing index of canonical paths. No code in this engine reads this file back; it is not kept in sync automatically, so treat path claims here as a starting point, not ground truth. Labelled 2026-08-23 (P8-084).
role: AI-operated visualization infrastructure layer for data charts. docgen remains the authority for documents/diagrams; Recharts remains the app-UI layer.
